site.tagline: Yielding to the pull toward the edge of things
site.bio_short: Photographer and naturalist with a decade of experience capturing the natural world across remote landscapes.
site.bio_full:
I am a photographer and naturalist with more than a decade of experience capturing the natural world. I specialize in camera trapping — using remotely triggered cameras to capture images of elusive wildlife rarely observed otherwise.

Available for editorial assignments, brand expeditions, and conservation documentation worldwide.
